claims: C1 the role of a message specifies the source of that message
C2 roles determine the authority of instructions in the case of conflicts, as described in the levels of authority and chain of command

concepts.name: message
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose role is defined by the Model Spec
concepts.inference: the node's claim concerns messages and their roles; the source text speaks of 'each message'

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: message M has role R, where R is one of system, developer, user, assistant or tool; the role specifies the source of the message

concepts.name: role_source
concepts.gloss: the role R of a message is the source S of that message
concepts.inference: the source text says 'role: specifies the source of each message'; a relation between role and source is needed to express that

concepts.name: instruction_role
concepts.gloss: instruction I is carried by a message whose role is R
concepts.inference: the source text says roles determine the authority of instructions; instructions must therefore be attached to roles

concepts.name: instruction_authority_by_role
concepts.gloss: the authority of instruction I is determined by role R in a conflict
concepts.inference: the source text says roles determine the authority of instructions in conflicts; a relation between instruction, role and authority is needed

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: level H outranks level L in the ranking root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text refers to 'levels of authority' without defining the ranking

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text refers to 'chain of command' without defining the principle

ontology.gloss: M is a message with role R, and R specifies the source of M
